Feel…Nakhon Phanom — A City Branding Campaign

Campaign and visual identity by Ammily Prain, 2026.

Project overview

A tourism campaign designed to reimagine Nakhon Phanom as a destination for relaxation and slow travel. This project translates the city's peaceful atmosphere and local identity into a contemporary visual language, extending beyond campaign design into new activities and a proposed tourism hub called LOMCHOY.

Target audience and insight

The campaign focuses on Gen Y working adults who seek a break from their busy routines. Travel is not just about going somewhere, but finding a moment to unwind.

The big idea

Just Feel Nakhon Phanom. Inspired by Slow Travel, the concept highlights the province's peaceful atmosphere and unhurried way of life.

Campaign visual identity

Logo, typography, color palette, graphic elements, campaign media and souvenirs. The visual language draws on local art, culture and architecture.

From campaign to experience

LOMCHOY: a new creative tourism hub connecting visitors, the city and local communities through a creative landmark, workshops and a curated souvenir space. Fragrance is the hero product, connecting place, emotion and memory.

Expected impact and future possibilities

Destination identity, local communities and lasting memories. The campaign can grow into local craft, slow cycling, wellness retreats and design activities.

This project was developed for the Chongchang 11th competition and remains a conceptual design proposal. It has not been implemented in the real world.
